integrity: The proof is self-contained for the new explicit fan, wall, restriction and curve computations and references the general fan criterion and family smoothness; exact integer checker included. No external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the subfamily Z_doubleprime_13(-2,2,0,d), integers d>=2, over the complex numbers is classified as to canonical tensor-generation obstruction. General surface-only examples predate this result; no classification of all quadruples is claimed. Existing implicit calculations may precede the present explicit answer.
title: Surface-only canonical obstructions in an Oda–Miyake toric family
